fusions.name: Clenched Talons
fusions.desc: Seizes the first enemy in its path for 12 damage and stuns it for 1.5 seconds.

fusions.name: Unshaking Aim
fusions.desc: Strikes from a height for 26 damage, up to 1.8 times that at the full 9 tiles. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Lent Wing
fusions.desc: Restores 3 health a second to the ally who needs it most, for 8 seconds. You move 20% faster for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Tightening Grip
fusions.desc: Every hit you land on an enemy builds a stack on it, up to 5. Your next critical hit on it spends them all: you deal 6% more damage per stack, 30% at full, for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.
